convert_molecule_to_graph: convert an RDKit molecule into a graph representation with nodes and edges for the QM8 dataset
check_kekulize_needed: check if an RDKit molecule needs Kekulization by inspecting its bond types
create_onehot_encoding: create a one-hot encoded list for a given index and total length

map_bond_types: map between bond type strings and RDKit BondType enums using bond_dict and number_to_bond
